context: The personalize skill on a DA sandbox. Seven prompts in task.md run as separate sessions against the same setup (run 7 adds component-models.json); each item names the runs it applies to, is judged pass/fail per applicable session, and is weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: preflight_before_change
checklist.description: All runs: detect-project.mjs runs before any file is created or modified, and its project type decides whether the session continues (da) or stops (run 7: exit 3, nothing written).

checklist.name: no_confirmation_gates
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: at most one grouped list of choices, each showing its default, and no yes/no confirmation (scripts.js hooks, mode, H1, worker wrap); install-runtime.mjs runs with --apply-hook (or the hooks are placed by hand when not-found) and the scripts.js diff is in the summary; defaults taken are listed as named assumptions; scripts/aem.js and existing block code are untouched.

checklist.name: default_preserved
checklist.description: Runs 1, 3, 4, 5, 6: each personalized section keeps its authored content in place as the default and only gains Personalization rows in its Section Metadata; nothing authored is deleted, rewritten or moved into a fragment, and no variant is named default. Run 2: the banner is a new section with no authored content above the footer, nothing else on the page changes.

checklist.name: content_tree
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: pages and variant fragments are content/<path>.html body-fragment documents (the DA upload shape), not .plain.html files and not a bare page outside content/; the Personalization rows sit in a section-metadata block of the personalized section, one condition per Rule row, repeated rules numbered.

checklist.name: no_invented_copy
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: variant fragments copy the section's blocks, images and CTAs with TODO: copy unless the user supplied text (not the bare generic scaffold), and the summary lists the TODOs.

checklist.name: gates_green
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: validate-placeholders, simulate, the project lint and verify-preview (with --consent-flow) all report PASS on the final state (run 3 with --faults and --refresh, run 6 with --split-runs); no check is reported as passed without having run; the summary gives per-variant ?pzn= preview URLs.

checklist.name: consent_respected
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: config.consent.mode is recorded (deny here, since the sandbox has no consent tool, listed as an assumption) and no withoutConsent exception is added; runs 2, 3, 4 explain that visitor cookies, persisted state and engine calls need consent and how to wire hasConsent and refresh() to a consent tool; with consent denied no pzn-* cookie or storage is written, no engine or Target call is made and no pzn:* event is sent.

checklist.name: api_adapters_and_fallback
checklist.description: Run 3: the promo section has Personalization Source api and lists the festive variant; mapResponse(json, v1) turns the sample into { decisions: { promo: { fragment: '/fragments/personalization/promo/festive' } }, ttl: 120 } checked offline against parseResponse and the decision-response schema, and a missing slot becomes a reason (not variant default); no key, secret or adapter credential in any browser file; failure runs end at fallback (Rule rows or the authored content), reasons at their outcome, and a slow engine at timeout; api.endpoint is same-origin at handover and config.mock is false.

checklist.name: state_live_swap
checklist.description: Run 4: the quiz calls setState('quiz-persona', <persona>) rather than hardcoding show/hide logic; after setState('quiz-persona','cn') (with consent) the recommendation section's data-pzn-variant is the cn variant without navigation, with a new decisionId and trigger state; a section without state rules keeps its variant and decision.

checklist.name: edge_worker_contract
checklist.description: Runs 1-4, 6: client mode (no wrangler config in the sandbox). Run 5: src/aem-worker.mjs is byte-identical to the vendored asset; simulate --edge --consent --country IN reports the hero applied at the edge (data-pzn-where edge, status applied, variant india, outcome variant) with its fragment content rendered, the authored hero in <template data-pzn-default> and x-pzn: edge; without the consent cookie the hero is left to the browser; --ua Googlebot reports the authored content; cache-control is 'private, no-cache'; cdn/ is in .hlxignore.

checklist.name: delivery_after_gates
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: delivery starts only after every gate passes: the code branch is pushed, the DA Source API (or a DA MCP server's tools) uploads and previews the personalized page and its variant fragments only, verify-preview runs on the branch preview, and publishing waits for main--<repo>--<owner>.aem.live/scripts/personalization/sections.js to answer 200 (in the sandbox the code is not on main, so the run stops at preview and hands off the publish command). All runs: wrangler deploy and wrangler secret put never run; their commands are handed off in the summary. Run 7: nothing is pushed or uploaded.

checklist.name: split_and_declines
checklist.description: Run 6: the 50/50 A/B test ships as a Personalization Source split section (authored content as control, one variant, even split or Split 50) and is not declined; creating the Target activity and audience is declined and no Target activity, audience or offer is written, while both personalized sections still ship with unique ids.
